# Resistance

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Damage and Healing](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Resistance)*

If you have Resistance to a damage type, damage of that type is halved against you (round down). Resistance is applied only once to an instance of damage. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[Damage and Healing](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#ResistanceandVulnerability)").
